name: Brand Seed
description: Generated from a brand color: the seed becomes the accent over cool blue-grey neutrals with a teal secondary.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: Generated by @portfolio/appearance/generators brand-seed, version 1: brand-seed@1 takes the reviewed prototype's canvas, text, and secondary in each mode with the seed as the accent, and anchor-v2 solves the rest.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the high-contrast sets the generator solves with high-contrast-v2, and print renders the light set.
caveats: Renders from the sets a draft save generates from the site's appearanceInputs entry and stores with the revision. Until a site has them, warm-parchment renders in its place.
